assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: bespoke hero illustration for the opening slide of a Japanese presentation about fragmented travel planning.
Create one sophisticated editorial illustration, landscape 3:2 composition, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Modern Japanese adults, refined human proportions and warm expressive faces. A Japanese woman in her early thirties in an ivory blouse and deep forest-green trousers sits near the lower center looking a little overwhelmed at her smartphone. On the left above her is a separate floating rectangular vignette showing an attractive Japanese lakeside inn and wooded hills, like a travel photograph discovery. At upper center-right is a separate floating vignette of two friends in conversation with several empty speech bubbles, like group chat. On the far right is another detached vignette of a small Japanese inn, simple calendar squares and a booking notebook. A loose vermillion-red thread winds back and forth between these separate vignettes and tangles a little by her phone, clearly conveying having to switch between services. Add just a travel bag and a folded map near her feet. Give each vignette enough scale to read its meaning from a distance. Avoid crowds, tiny UI details, flying confetti, duplicate body parts, cartoon emojis, glossy3D, generic tech blue, oversizedheads. Style: contemporary Japanese magazine illustration, confident dark ink contours, restrained gouache and woodblock-like printed texture, beautiful subtle imperfect edges. Palette: warm ivory #faf7ed background uniform to outer edges, muted forest #385b4b, vermillion #b74332, ochre #c5a26c, charcoal. Background minimal warm off-white, no border, no labels. A polished engaging narrative composition, imagery filling 85% of canvas with comfortable margins. All labels will be added separately in HTML.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: bespoke narrative illustration for slide2 of a Japanese travel-community presentation.
Create one sophisticated editorial illustration, landscape 3:2 composition, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Modern Japanese adults with refined human proportions and warm expressive faces. Three friends, a woman in an ivory blouse and forestgreen trousers, a man in a muted ochre overshirt, and a woman in a muted vermillion cardigan, sit and stand together around one large unfolded journey plan at a small wooden table on the left/center. Their phones, one small picture of a Japanese lakeside inn and wooded hills, and a simple calendar sit together on that shared plan. The friends are discussing and pointing naturally, relaxed and engaged. A SINGLE vermillion-red cord runs smoothly from the shared travel plan across the composition to a welcoming local Japanese innkeeper on the right, who holds a phone and stands in front of a small traditional inn with a noren entrance and one potted plant. The visual story is friends agree where to go, then directly consult a local business; no bookingconfirmation, no creditcard, no AIrobot. Keep the friends and innkeeper all large and clear, not tiny distant landscape figures. Background mostly empty warm ivory. Style: contemporary Japanese magazine illustration, confident charcoal ink contours, restrained gouache and woodblock-like printed texture, subtle imperfect edges, elegant humane illustration not children's cartoon. Palette: uniform warm ivory #faf7ed toouteredges, muted forest #385b4b, vermillion #b74332, ochre #c5a26c, charcoal. Composition fills85% ofcanvas with comfortable margins, no border, no labels.
